name: Витрина «За Энериум»: зал Безликих и пятеро «Менял» — донатный сет цикла II (ADR-0021, ADR-0022, ADR-0023). Слова автора 29.09.2026: «За Энериум тоже сделать интереснее и дорого-богато, это всё-таки окно для донатных игроков… чтобы игрок хотел купить героев. Можешь генерить арты». Безликие — без лица (ADR-0023, п. 10): лица нет, стёрлось; имя и облик — одежда, силуэт, приметы ремесла — видны сразу; капюшон не запрещён. Для арта первого сета автор назвал образ: «безликие тени — дементоры, назгулы» (ADR-0021, п. 4). Портреты — по способу «Глубокий промт персонажа» (art/style/style.md): кто он и чего хочет сейчас · характер телом · поза словами в миг действия · пять личных деталей из глав · место. Кадр — как у героев (heroes-batch-03.json): по пояс, корпус вправо, к врагам, камера чуть снизу. Источники: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Образцы глав» — Донатный сет II «Менялы»; состав-героев.csv c2-59…c2-63. Зал — фон витрины 21:9: спокойная середина, туда интерфейс ставит пять рам. Свет витрины — зелёный Энериума (время, #4fdc8b) и старое золото.
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, precious, regal: rich materials — old gold, dark bronze, black stone, deep green velvet. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold green light of time-crystals against warm gold. Fine sand and dust motes float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin, not a statue.

donat-hall.frame: Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: a wide cinematic background, 21:9, for the showcase screen of a shop in a mobile game. Seen straight on at the height of a standing person, a calm symmetric composition with depth. The middle band of the picture stays calm, dim and uncluttered: the interface places five portrait frames there. The richest detail and the brightest light gather at the left and right edges and along the bottom. No people, no figures, no statues, no portraits, no faces.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they were; the pose carries weight and intent. The head in the upper third; the lower quarter may be darker because the card puts the name there. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below; rim light separates the figure from the background.

This hero is one of the Faceless: a soul of the distant past whose face has long been worn away, and who does not remember who they were. Where the face should be there is only a smooth, soft darkness, like shadow pooled inside the hood or head-covering — the face rubbed away like the face of an old coin. No eyes, no glowing eyes, no nose, no mouth, no mask, no skull, no features at all in that darkness. Everything else about the hero is vivid and specific: the clothing, the silhouette, the tools of the trade and above all the hands — alive, strong and expressive; the hands and the trade tell who they were. Fine green sand of time drifts from the edges of the cloak and from the fingertips and floats upward — the mark of the timeless. The rarity is the highest in the game: the portrait feels precious and regal, with old gold highlights and deep green light.

jobs.subject: Subject: the Hall of the Faceless — a vast treasury vault deep inside an ancient timeless tower, where the memory of the faceless is kept. Tall arches of black stone inlaid with old gold recede into darkness on both sides; between them hang heavy curtains of deep green velvet with gold fringe. In small niches along the side walls stand sealed hourglasses with glowing green sand and closed brass-bound coffers. Across the whole lower part of the picture runs a broad, low dais of polished black marble veined with gold; from long cracks along its front edge and from green time-crystals set into the floor below, green light rises upward and lights the arches from below. High above, a few hanging lamps of old gold give warm light. Fine golden sand and dust drift slowly in the air like a slow snowfall. Rich, regal, mysterious and quiet — a treasury where something precious waits.

jobs.subject: Subject: Arno the Weigher, a man of the golden age of the ancient roads, one of the Faceless. Who he is: the salt weigher at a station on an ancient road, in the years when caravans went again along roads they did not know. His measure was always exact; nobody remembered his face — people remembered him by his measure. Right now he sets his worn brass weight on the scale to settle a caravan master's dispute: the pan drops and the needle stands true. Character: calm, exact and incorruptible, with a quiet dignity — his shoulders square, his back straight as a scale beam, every movement precise and unhurried, utterly sure of his measure. Pose, the moment of the weighing: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right, leaning a little over a heavy set of brass merchant scales that stands at waist height at the right side of the picture. He has exactly two arms: his near hand has just set a small brass weight on the right pan, the fingers still open just above it; his far hand holds the beam of the scales steady at its pivot. The pans swing, and grains of white salt leap from the other pan into the light. Details that tell his story: (1) the brass weight is rubbed to a bright shine by a thousand fingers; (2) a leather satchel of salt at his hip, white crystals spilling from its mouth; (3) a long travelling coat of heavy undyed wool with brass buttons, dusted with salt; (4) a deep hood of worn brown cloth frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (5) a small brass tally-token hangs from a cord around his wrist. Place: a stone way-station on an ancient road at dusk; behind him, in soft focus, a loaded caravan waits — pack animals and bales — and white salt flats stretch beyond. Warm amber light from a lantern at his feet, and green time-light rising from cracks in the old paving stones below.

jobs.title: Ренар Водонос — Безликий, фармер, донатный сет II «Менялы», 2-й (c2-60)
jobs.source: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Образцы глав» — Ренар Водонос, «Бочка чистой воды»: арка с синим камнем (Паладиум — синий карст) над водой гавани Лайтен-Гарда, вода кораблям, «торгует не водой, а уверенностью»; обрывки «Синий камень над водой», «Бочка тяжелее, чем кажется», «Пьют не глядя». Решение агента: вязаная шапка и шарф, фляги на поясе, скол синего камня на шнурке. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-60.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Renar the Water-Bearer, a man of a great harbor city, one of the Faceless. Who he is: he sold water to ships in the harbor of Laiten-Gard, where under arches set with blue Paladium stones the water is always clean; captains paid not for the water but for being able to drink it without looking. He said he traded not in water but in certainty. Right now he heaves a full barrel of clean water up onto his shoulder to carry it up the gangway of a ship. Character: sure, sturdy and proud of his honest trade — a broad back, a steady stride, not a moment of hesitation, a man everyone trusts. Pose, the moment of the lift: the camera is low; he strides toward the right up a wooden gangway, his weight thrown onto his leading side. He has exactly two arms: his near hand and shoulder are under a heavy oak barrel bound with iron hoops, just heaved up onto his near shoulder; his far hand grips a taut rope of the gangway. Clean water splashes from the barrel's bung and flashes in the light. Details that tell his story: (1) the barrel is dark wet oak with iron hoops, a tin ladle hanging from its side; (2) his sleeves are rolled up, the forearms corded with muscle and wet to the elbow; (3) a sailor's knitted cap and a long scarf wound around his head and neck frame the smooth darkness where his face should be; (4) a belt with a row of stoppered water flasks; (5) a small chip of blue stone on a cord at his throat, like the stones of the harbor arches. Place: the harbor of Laiten-Gard at dawn: a great stone arch set with glowing blue Paladium stones over dark calm water, the hulls and masts of ships in soft focus. Blue light from the arch stones and from the water below, green time-light rising from the wet planks.

jobs.title: Мэлин с Аванпоста — Безликая, эльфийка, фармер, донатный сет II «Менялы», 3-я (c2-61)
jobs.source: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Образцы глав» — Мэлин с Аванпоста, «Прилавок у кромки леса»: прилавок у кромки Алаэля, лес по щепотке — кора от жара, трава от ожогов, отдала всю корзину мальчику без денег и села на корень; обрывки «Щепоть — медяк, горсть — серебро», «За кромку нельзя», «Корни тёплые». Решение агента: шаль на голове, кончики ушей, пальцы в соке коры, медные весы для щепоти. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-61.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Maelin of the Outpost, an elven woman, one of the Faceless. Who she is: she traded elven remedies at an outpost on the very edge of the great elven forest, where all the trade goes — behind her the forest, in front of her people with money. She never let people past the edge: she sold them the forest a pinch at a time — bark against fever, herbs against burns. On her last day a boy came with no money and burned hands, and she gave him the whole basket. Right now she holds out a whole basket of remedies across her stall. Character: shrewd and warm at once — a trader's sharpness and a healer's kindness; poised, graceful and generous, her movement light and sure. Pose, the moment of the gift: the camera is low; she stands turned toward the right, leaning forward over her stall. She has exactly two arms: her near arm stretches toward the right and holds out a wide woven basket full of bark strips, bundled herbs and small clay jars; her far hand presses a sprig of healing herb to her chest. Loose leaves lift from the basket into the light. Details that tell her story: (1) a long shawl of moss-green wool drawn over her head frames the smooth darkness where her face should be, and the tips of her long pointed elven ears show through it; (2) her fingers are stained brown with bark and sap; (3) a tiny copper scale for pinches and a small purse of coins hang from her belt; (4) a string of dried leaves and seed pods around her neck; (5) a thick old root curls up at her feet, where she will sit to rest. Place: a small wooden trading stall at the very edge of a vast primeval forest: huge pale trunks rise behind her, the open road and passing traders in soft focus beyond. Soft pale-green forest light, and green time-light rising from the moss and roots below.

jobs.subject: Subject: Gest the Fire-Seller, a man of the northern lands, one of the Faceless. Who he is: he carried Nitrium — the scarlet fire stone — to the south: the south has stone, but not what makes it blaze. He despised his buyers and never cheated a single one: lying to those you do not respect is too much honour. Winter took him halfway home, with a stone in his hand. Right now he raises a blazing scarlet stone high like a torch against the blizzard. Character: proud, harsh, contemptuous and unbreakable — braced against the cold, broad shoulders squared, not an inch of retreat. Pose, the moment of defiance: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right, leaning into the wind. He has exactly two arms: his near arm is thrust up and forward and holds a fist-sized scarlet Nitrium crystal that blazes like a coal, its red light pouring over him; his far hand clutches the strap of a heavy pack on his back. Snow whips around him and melts in the stone's heat. Details that tell his story: (1) a heavy hood of wolf pelt, rimed with frost, frames the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) a sheepskin coat with iron clasps, a wide belt with a long knife; (3) the pack on his back is full of more red stones that glow through the leather; (4) the hand around the stone is bare and scarred by old burns — the only warm thing in the storm; (5) snow crusted thick on his shoulders. Place: a mountain pass on the road north in a blizzard, dark pines and drifts in soft focus. Scarlet light from the stone and from ember-red cracks in the ice below; faint green time-light at his feet.

jobs.title: Эйтри Замочник — Безликий, дворф, фармер, донатный сет II «Менялы», 5-й (c2-63)
jobs.source: docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Образцы глав» — Эйтри Замочник, «Связка ключей»: замки складам запада, кладовым севера и сундукам Эндалора, «замок продают всем, ключ — только по заказу», связка ключей к замкам, за которыми никто не пришёл, последняя смена у горна; обрывки «Щёлк — не тот», «Замок продают всем», «Ключ — по заказу». Решение агента: кожаный капюшон и заплетённая борода из тьмы, прожжённый фартук, незаконченный замок на наковальне. К выгрузке — design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-63.jpg, без mirror.
jobs.subject: Subject: Eitri the Locksmith, a dwarf, one of the Faceless. Who he is: he made locks for the warehouses of the west, the pantries of the north and the chests of Endalor: a lock is sold to everyone, a key only to order. On his belt hung a bunch of keys to locks nobody ever came back for. On his last shift he sat by the forge and sorted through them, as if looking for the right one. Right now he raises the great ring of keys and shakes it — the keys ring. Character: gruff, proud, meticulous and secretive — a master who trusts no one with a key. He is short and enormously broad: a barrel chest, a thick short neck, heavy arms. Pose, the moment he lifts the keys: the camera is low; he stands turned toward the right, planted like a rock. He has exactly two arms: his near hand lifts high a huge iron ring heavy with dozens of keys of every size, and holds out one long key between two fingers toward the right — offering it, or refusing it; his far hand rests heavily on the big iron lock of a chest beside him. Details that tell his story: (1) a leather hood, and a thick braided beard bound with iron rings that falls from the smooth darkness where his face should be; (2) a leather apron scorched by the forge, its pockets full of files, picks and a small hammer; (3) the keys are iron, brass and bronze, some hung with small blank metal tags; (4) his thick forearms are bare and pocked with spark scars; (5) a half-finished ornate lock lies on the anvil behind him. Place: a dwarven forge in a stone hall: the glowing mouth of the forge behind him, chains and hanging locks in soft focus. Orange forge light, and green time-light rising from cracks in the stone floor below.
